title: Deer with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='22' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#d4822a' transform='rotate(-25 28 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='22' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f0b060' transform='rotate(-25 28 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='22' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#d4822a' transform='rotate(25 72 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='22' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f0b060' transform='rotate(25 72 22)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M38 20 L34 6 L30 12 M38 20 L42 8' stroke='#c06a1e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 20 L66 6 L70 12 M62 20 L58 8' stroke='#c06a1e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#e8953a'/>
  <!-- face lighter area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f5c070'/>
  <!-- eyes with sparkle -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='40' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8b3a1a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 54 Q50 58 54 54' stroke='#8b3a1a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#f4a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#f4a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- neck / body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#e8953a'/>
  <!-- chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#f5c070'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='88' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#c06a1e'/>
  <rect x='58' y='88' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#c06a1e'/>
  <!-- sparkles around head -->
  <path d='M18 30 L20 28 L22 30 L20 32 Z' fill='#fff8a0'/>
  <path d='M82 30 L84 28 L86 30 L84 32 Z' fill='#fff8a0'/>
  <path d='M22 58 L24 56 L26 58 L24 60 Z' fill='#fff8a0'/>
  <path d='M78 58 L80 56 L82 58 L80 60 Z' fill='#fff8a0'/>
  <path d='M16 42 L17.5 40.5 L19 42 L17.5 43.5 Z' fill='#fff8a0'/>
  <path d='M81 42 L82.5 40.5 L84 42 L82.5 43.5 Z' fill='#fff8a0'/>
</svg>
